notes.title: WINDJAMMERS 2 - A MAJOR FREE DLC UPDATE JUST LAUNCHED TODAY!
notes.content:
[h2][b]WE’RE BACK WITH SOME GREAT NEWS!🎉[/b][/h2] 

We wanted to take the time necessary to review all feedback collected since the game launch to answer the problems raised with concrete solutions. It took more time than expected, we did encounter difficulties but we never gave up on what players were asking and needed to enjoy the game to the fullest. We hope that the new major free update going live today will help everyone get aboard the Windjammers hype train! 

[previewyoutube=Os_jGtikJCw;full][/previewyoutube]

After a year of dedicated hard work, the Windjammers 2 development team is thrilled to drop a NEW [b]MAJOR and FREE update[/b] adding two new playable characters, new modes, and several online features including the long-awaited Lobbies, spectator mode, and full crossplay support. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1114290/Windjammers_2/

[h3][b]MEET JAMMA GX03 AND ANNA SZALINSKI 🤖 🏋️[/b][/h3]

Jamma GX03 is a cutting-edge android powered by Flying Power League Federation major sponsor, Todemu. Thanks to her well-balanced power skills and incredible speed, she can challenge the best jammers on the court. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36051485/bcfd40bf1a41fcb6fdd409b6643ac4d03c7e335f.png[/img]

Anna Szalinski is an orphan raised in Poland. She first grew up in a company of circus performers before running away because of animal abuse she witnessed. The young and powerful weightlifter she became is determined to pursue her dream: to win the Flying Power League competition, and use her newfound position to defend wild animals mistreated in captivity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36051485/b9e633e2b077764fed6f651a4a5075698e684827.png[/img]

[h3][b]LET’S PRACTICE! 🥏[/b][/h3]

Based on player feedback received when Windjammers 2 launched last year, we decided to add two new modes: Lessons and Practice, to help all players get started with Windjammers 2 mechanics.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36051485/172a593b39ea24f69ef208eb43f236a9680c34f1.png[/img]

Lessons is a How To Play mode, allowing jammers to learn all the moves, from the basics (lob, curved, slapshot, and drop shot) to the most advanced techniques (jumps, Super Shots, etc.). 

The Practice mode will let you all jam the wind against the CPU while choosing the settings that suit you the best: force service, range of difficulty level, and more.

[b][h3]…LOBBIES & CROSSPLAY MAKING THEIR DEBUT TODAY![/h3][/b]

This major free update could not just end here. The incredible development team behind Windjammers 2 also decided to work on highly requested online features that we’re proud to announce: Lobbies and full Crossplay are making their debut in Windjammers 2 starting today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36051485/5982c17d1bee5eb98770d9fd8f683f8c7b044e66.png[/img]

You can either join or create a lobby to play with friends, using a password and a variety of settings to challenge your jammin’ buddies. 

Crossplay will allow the awesome people playing on Nintendo Switch and PlayStation to join Steam and Xbox jammers in fierce online matches. 

[b][i]Please note that the new online features require a total reset of the existing online rankings.[/i][/b]

Grab your best outfit, sunglasses, and flying disc, because it’s about to go down! 

-----

[b]Get Windjammers 2 on Steam if you haven’t:[/b] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1114290/Windjammers_2/ 

[b]Catch us on Twitter: [/b]
https://twitter.com/Windjammers 
https://twitter.com/Dotemu 

[b]…or Instagram and TikTok: [/b]
https://www.instagram.com/dotemugames/
https://www.tiktok.com/@dotemugames_ 

[b]We also have an official website: [/b]
https://www.windjammers2.com/

notes.title: WINDJAMMERS 2 FREE OPEN BETA IS NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Greetings Jammers,

We are waiting for you in the Arena, as [b]Windjammers 2 FREE open beta is now available till August 22! [/b]

For those of you who haven’t seen it yet,[b] Gary Scott’s masterclass is back[/b], along with [b]a tutorial video[/b]. Check it out now, before jumping into the Arena, and learn all the tricks to become the best Windjammer in the world:

[previewyoutube=mGO65VVWMSg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]<!> DISCLAIMER: Windjammers 2 beta contains flashing lights and patterns that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. If you or anyone in your family has an epileptic condition, consult your doctor before playing this beta. If you experience any of the following symptoms while playing Windjammers 2 beta - dizziness, blurred vision, eye or muscle twitches, loss of consciousness, disorientation, involuntary movements or seizures - stop playing IMMEDIATELY and consult your doctor before resuming play. <!>[/b]

[b]BEFORE JUMPING INTO THE ARENA:[/b]

Please note that Windjammers 2 demo is still a WIP, as a result, you may encounter a few known issues that the development team is already investigating and working on.

For this beta, we use a specific support system called [b]Feature Upvote[/b], to help you with your [b]technical issues[/b]: https://windjammers2pc.featureupvote.com/ 

To report an issue on [b]Feature Upvote[/b] that isn’t mentioned in the “Known Issues” list, please[b] ‘add your own suggestion’[/b], to start a new discussion and give us as many details as possible.
[list]
[*][b] All known issues are reported and pinned here: [/b] [url=https://windjammers2pc.featureupvote.com/suggestions/202616/known-issues-everything-you-need-to-know-on-wj2-open-beta]https://windjammers2pc.featureupvote.com/suggestions/202616/known-issues-everything-you-need-to-know-on-wj2-open-beta[/url]
[*] [b]Before reporting a technical issue, please read the FAQ here: [/b] [url=https://windjammers2pc.featureupvote.com/suggestions/201855/faq-steps-to-reproduce-before-reporting-a-technical-issue]https://windjammers2pc.featureupvote.com/suggestions/201855/faq-steps-to-reproduce-before-reporting-a-technical-issue[/url]
[*] [b]If you still have an issue after checking the above, please read the “FAQ - How to report a technical issue”, before posting anything:[/b] [url=https://windjammers2pc.featureupvote.com/suggestions/201854/faq-how-to-report-a-technical-issue]https://windjammers2pc.featureupvote.com/suggestions/201854/faq-how-to-report-a-technical-issue[/url]
[/list]
All feedback is appreciated as long as [u][b]everyone remains civil and gives constructive reactions[/b][/u]. Feel free to share your thoughts with us on the forum or on Windjammers 2 official Discord server: https://discord.gg/rDVyU9W


[b]Quick reminder - Windjammers 2 FREE open beta includes:[/b]

[b]Four playable characters:[/b] Steve Miller, Gary Scott, Loris Biaggi, Sophie De Lys
[b]Four stages:[/b] Beach, Ring, Rooftop(NEW), Stadium
[b]One game mode:[/b] Ranked Online ([i]Play with Friends[/i] is not available in this beta, as we’re currently working on making this feature more stable).
[b]Online leaderboards [/b]
[b]Ping display options and input delay settings[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36051485/7fa81bdb0aad3df6a74ef85ce9db51f5117f78e7.png[/img]

notes.title: WINDJAMMERS 2 FREE OPEN BETA WILL BE LIVE TOMORROW
notes.content:
Greetings Jammers,

It’s finally time to go back into the Arena and jam the wind, as [b]Windjammers 2 FREE open beta will be available tomorrow![/b] We know it's been a long wait, but we are very excited to have you back for this beta [b]starting on August 11 at 3PM CEST and ending on August 22.[/b]

Oh, and if you're feeling a bit rusty from waiting, it seems like an iconic jammer has some tips for you, check it out:

[previewyoutube=mGO65VVWMSg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]<!> DISCLAIMER: Windjammers 2 beta contains flashing lights and patterns that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. If you or anyone in your family has an epileptic condition, consult your doctor before playing this beta. If you experience any of the following symptoms while playing Windjammers 2 beta - dizziness, blurred vision, eye or muscle twitches, loss of consciousness, disorientation, involuntary movements or seizures - stop playing IMMEDIATELY and consult your doctor before resuming play. <!>[/b]


[b]RIGHT ON GARY![/b]

Now that you are fully ready to play, we suggest you take a look at the open beta available features:

[list]
[*] [b]Four playable characters:[/b] Steve Miller, Gary Scott, Loris Biaggi, Sophie De Lys
[*] [b]Four stages:[/b] Beach, Ring, Rooftop(NEW), Stadium
[*] [b]Game mode:[/b] Ranked Online (Play with Friends is not available)
[*] [b]Online leaderboards [/b]
[/list]
Please note that Windjammers 2 demo is still a WIP, as a result, you may encounter a few known issues that the development team is already investigating and working on.

For this beta, we use a specific support system called [b]Feature Upvote[/b], to help you with your technical issues: https://windjammers2pc.featureupvote.com/ 

Since our last demo, we have acknowledged all your feedback and added [b]ping display options and input delay settings.[/b] Regarding the [i]Play With Friends[/i] feature, which we know is important to you, we are currently working on making this feature more stable, so that your experience can be the best possible, when the game is released. Keep in mind that if your previous suggestions have not been included in this beta, it does not mean that they have not been taken into account. 

Indeed, all feedback is appreciated as long as[u][b] everyone remains civil and gives constructive reactions. [/b][/u]Feel free to share your thoughts with us on the forum or on [b]Windjammers 2 official Discord server:[/b] https://discord.gg/rDVyU9W

On behalf of the entire Windjammers 2 team: thank you all for your amazing support, patience and unconditional love! You all have been so thrilled by our last demo, so we can’t wait for you to try this open beta and share with us your thoughts and experiences. 

[b]Make sure to add Windjammers 2 to your wishlist:[/b] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1114290/Windjammers_2/
